articles.summary: Covista, America's Largest Healthcare Educator, Opening First Tennessee Location to Help Address the State's Widening Nursing Shortage New Campus Will Be Chamberlain's 27th Location Nationwide Chamberlain University, America's largest school of nursing and a Covista (NYSE: CVSA) institution, today announced it will open a new campus in Nashville, Tennessee, its first location in the state. The campus continues Chamberlain's national expansion strategy to address the U.S. healthcare workforce shortage and will offer day, evening and weekend class options, giving students more flexible opportunities to pursue a nursing degree. The university will begin accepting applications on September 9, 2026, with pre-licensure Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) classes beginning January 4, 2027. The new campus is a direct response to Tennessee's widening healthcare workforce gap. articles.summary: Dunne returns to the nation's largest school of nursing to advance student success and academic excellence Chamberlain University, a Covista institution and the nation's largest school of nursing, today announced Jason Dunne, DNP, MBA, MN, RN, as its next Chief Academic Officer, effective Sept. 14, 2026. Dunne will report to Amelia Manning, President, Chamberlain University, and will lead academic strategy, faculty development and curriculum across the university’s campuses and online programs nationwide, serving approximately 40,000 students. Most recently, Dunne served as Chief Academic Officer at Arizona College of Nursing, where he provided academic leadership across more than 20 BSN campuses and helped lead the institution through significant growth, including the opening of 14 new campuses in four years.
